args.title: Saltmarsh Foods – Retail Returns Logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest issue covers "Retail returns logistics," linking to their blog article and holding a webinar seat for Hana at the companion page.
- Linked article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidating return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion): Resale within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
